content.paragraph1: In facing global dynamics and strengthening the existence of international standard Islamic education, a shared platform is needed that can encourage synergy between institutions.
content.paragraph2: The International Islamic Education Consortium (KOPIN) is present as a strategic step to form a collaborative ecosystem among A-accredited Islamic schools/pesantren with global standards in Indonesia.
content.paragraph3: Through this forum, it is hoped that productive cooperation will be built in various fields, such as curriculum development, student and teacher exchange, collaborative research, and promotion of Indonesian Islamic education at the international level.

fgd1.title: FGD 1 Highlights:
fgd1.description: This Focus Group Discussion (FGD) aims to identify strategic steps that can be taken by Islamic schools in the process towards international standards. This FGD also serves as a platform for exchange of ideas, experiences, and strategies from various Islamic schools that have or are moving towards that stage.
fgd1.highlight2: exchange of ideas, experiences, and strategies

fgd2.title: FGD 2:
fgd2.description: This topic discusses the internationalization strategy of Islamic education to be able to compete globally without losing Islamic identity. It provides insights on how Islamic educational institutions can develop relevant and inclusive curricula, strengthen teacher and management quality, and forge global partnerships to build superior, adaptive, and sustainable Islamic education at the international level.

data.name: Prof. Muhammad Zuhdi M.Ed., Ph.D.
data.description: Prof. Zuhdi is a Professor of Education at UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta, a graduate of University of New South Wales and McGill University. He has served as Education Director of Jalan Sesama (Sesame Street Indonesia), Editor-in-Chief of Tarbiya Journal, and advisor to UNESCO and the Ministry of Religious Affairs of Indonesia. His research focus includes Islamic education, inclusion, and student welfare, published in international journals. In 2011, he received the Australian Alumni Award for Excellence in Education from the Australian Embassy.

data.name: Dr. Supangat, MA
data.description: Dr. Supangat, MA is a national trainer, postgraduate lecturer, and Islamic school manager with more than 20 years of experience in developing quality-based, character-driven, and innovative Islamic education. With academic background from UIN Sunan Kalijaga, UGM, McGill University, and Sydney University, he actively trains teachers, develops curricula, and leads prominent Islamic schools. His works in critical education, active learning, and school management serve as references in various educational institutions in Indonesia.

fgd3.title: FGD 3:
fgd3.titleSubtitle: Leading the Implementation of the IB Programme
fgd3.description1: In order to strengthen synergy and strategic leadership in the implementation of the International Baccalaureate (IB) Programme, this Focused Group Discussion (FGD) carries the theme "From Vision to Action: Leading the Implementation of the IB Programme."
fgd3.description2: This activity aims to serve as a platform for exchange of ideas, strategies, and best practices in directing the global education vision into concrete actions in educational institutions. Stakeholders—including principals, IB coordinators, learning facilitators, and other related parties—will engage in in-depth discussions regarding challenges, opportunities, and transformative leadership approaches in the context of IB program implementation.
fgd3.highlight2: exchange of ideas, strategies, and best practices

data.name: Mr. Faizol Musa
data.role: Former Acting Head of Development for Asia-Pacific at IB
data.description: Faizol Musa is an international education expert with more than 20 years of experience in K-12 and higher education. He previously served as Acting Head of Development for the Asia-Pacific region at International Baccalaureate (IB), and is now a member of the Board of Directors at Manipal GlobalNxt University. His expertise includes IB curriculum development (DP, MYP, CP), education market expansion, and cross-country institutional accreditation. Experienced in leading strategic projects in South and Southeast Asia, Faizol is also active in policy advocacy, global partnerships (with Microsoft, ACCA, Arizona State University), and edtech innovation. His expertise in project management, strategic finance, and organizational development makes him a key figure in global education transformation.

about.title: About EduNation Fest
about.description: EduNation Fest will be a dynamic and inclusive platform to encourage the development of the education sector in Indonesia, promoting educational institutions through active roles from all institutions in innovative and creative ways.

objectives.title: Launch Objectives
items: Socialize KOPIN's vision and strategic direction as a collaborative platform for national and international Islamic educational institutions.
Explore ideas and best practices to build world-class, relevant, and Quranic values-based Islamic education.
Encourage synergy between institutions through curriculum collaboration, student/teacher exchanges, and institutional cooperation.
